description: This header file defines network-related function declarations, macros, and error handling for the lighttpd project. It includes network read/write operations, error handling, and support for platform-specific sendfile optimizations.

methods.name: li_network_error_quark
methods.description: Returns a GQuark representing the network error domain used for GLib error handling.

methods.name: li_net_write
methods.description: Performs a write operation, repeating on EINTR, to the specified file descriptor.

methods.name: li_net_read
methods.description: Performs a read operation, repeating on EINTR, from the specified file descriptor.

methods.name: li_network_write
methods.description: Writes data from a chunk queue up to a maximum size, returning a status.

methods.name: li_network_read
methods.description: Reads data into a chunk queue and buffer up to specified maximum sizes, returning a status.

methods.name: li_network_write_writev
methods.description: Uses writev for memory chunks and buffered read/write for files to perform combined write operations.

methods.name: li_network_write_sendfile
methods.description: Uses sendfile for file data transfer if supported by platform, otherwise falls back.

methods.name: li_network_backend_write
methods.description: Backend function to write data to network using chunk queues.

methods.name: li_network_backend_writev
methods.description: Backend function to write data using writev system call.
